name: hud_ui_panel_destructor
description: HudUiPanel::~HudUiPanel destroys any textPick image, releases the font object, and is reached through the recovered thunk/scalar-deleting destructor path.
known_limits: The native smoke covers the no-owned-image/no-font path through ScalarDeletingDestructor; broader owned-resource behavior is covered by zVid image destroy provider tests.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja 0x4bab40 shows complete C++ destructor shape with optional zVid_Image::Destroy for textPick and DeleteObject on hFont.
The native panel scalar-deleting destructor smoke validates that flags 0 keeps stack storage and flags 1 releases heap storage after running the recovered destructor path.
